title: Empirical Measurement of Aesthetic Experience of Music
reasoning: The paper focuses on the physiological measurement of aesthetic and emotional responses (goosebumps/frisson) to music, describing a device and methodology. It does not engage in evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics in a substantial way, although it touches on 'aesthetic experience' and 'transcendental psychophysiological moments' which are treated within a scientific context.
